question_vi: Top 5 khách hàng có doanh thu cao nhất tháng 6/2026?
question_en: Top 5 customers by revenue in June 2026
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.full_name, SUM(p.amount) AS revenue FROM payments AS p JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = p.order_id JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE p.status = 'succeeded' AND p.paid_at >= '2026-06-01' AND p.paid_at < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.full_name ORDER BY revenue DESC, c.customer_id ASC LIMIT 5
notes: Glossary trap: 'doanh thu' is payments.amount WHERE status='succeeded' anchored on paid_at, NOT orders.total_amount on created_at. Verified: 5 rows on the seeded snapshot, top revenue 595388550.83.

question_vi: Doanh thu quý 2/2026 chia theo miền?
question_en: Q2 2026 revenue broken down by region
gold_sql: SELECT r.region_name, SUM(p.amount) AS revenue FROM payments AS p JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = p.order_id JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN regions AS r ON r.region_id = c.region_id WHERE p.status = 'succeeded' AND p.paid_at >= '2026-04-01' AND p.paid_at < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY r.region_name ORDER BY revenue DESC
notes: Four-table join. Region comes from customers.region_id, not addresses.region_id — a customer may have several addresses, which double-counts revenue if joined that way. Verified: 3 rows, Miền Nam highest.

question_vi: 10 sản phẩm bán chạy nhất theo số lượng trong năm 2026?
question_en: Top 10 best-selling products by quantity in 2026
gold_sql: SELECT pr.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS pr ON pr.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.created_at >= '2026-01-01' AND o.created_at < '2027-01-01' AND o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY pr.product_name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC, pr.product_name ASC LIMIT 10
notes: Cancelled orders excluded — 'bán chạy' means sold, not ordered-then-cancelled. Time anchor is orders.created_at (when it was sold), not products.created_at. Verified: 10 rows, top 377 units.

question_vi: Có bao nhiêu khách hàng ở miền Nam đang ở trạng thái active?
question_en: How many customers in the South region have status active
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers AS c JOIN regions AS r ON r.region_id = c.region_id WHERE r.region_code = 'SOUTH' AND c.status = 'active'
notes: Deliberately says 'trạng thái active' so it maps to customers.status literally. The bare term 'khách hàng active' is a DIFFERENT, unverified glossary entry (needs a recency window) and belongs in the ambiguous slice that measures clarification rate. Verified: 1 row, 1686.

question_vi: Số đơn hàng bị huỷ theo từng kênh bán trong 6 tháng đầu năm 2026?
question_en: Cancelled order count per sales channel in H1 2026
gold_sql: SELECT o.channel, COUNT(*) AS cancelled_orders FROM orders AS o WHERE o.status = 'cancelled' AND o.created_at >= '2026-01-01' AND o.created_at < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY cancelled_orders DESC, o.channel ASC
notes: Single-table baseline item. completed_at is NULL for cancelled orders, so created_at is the only usable time anchor — a query written against completed_at returns zero rows and looks 'valid'. Verified: 4 rows, web 374.
